node.statement: The datum furnished by lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope is the explicit closed EXT-CB input datum for lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension; def-maincb-raw-call does not force a literal output map to be fixed before that extension theorem is applied. Apply lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension to this closed EXT-CB datum and choose one witness v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R whose fixed amplification family makes it an extended D_2 t-isomorphism and whose unit error is at most D_2 t. Form the corresponding Stage-2 def-maincb-raw-call record by taking its literal output map u_2 and fixed amplification family to be exactly this chosen v_+ and its amplification family, while retaining the supplied inputs, source, target corner, base scale, post-helper scale, target ambient defect, and recorded raw-defect data. Thus u_2:=v_+ by construction, not by an inference from a pre-existing raw-call record.
